第13章 霸道的副宗主（第1页）
大长老看着自己的孙子被李天一脚踢飞出去，对李天有了必杀之心。当即飞出长老席，喂下两颗疗伤丹。然后叫人带下去休养。
李天再次道，当初他们欺负我的时候可曾有人为我说过一句话。他们在其它擂台废掉那些同门师兄弟的时候你可曾说过一句话，现在是你孙子受伤。你心疼了？
李天这句话得到了很多人的赞同，特别是受伤严重的那些人，大长老这是严重包庇自己家人，所有人都觉得李天说的有道理。
但是无论李天怎么说？大长老田龙都得让李天死，谁也阻止不了，把自己孙子打成了废人，而且两个。如果有生之年不能提升到天神境，那一辈子就是残废了。
执法堂，还不动手，这种魔头留他干嘛？看着执法堂的人发愣，大长老吼道。
丹堂张图也站了出来，要拿下李天。
眼看执法堂就要去抓李天，这个时候王维和站了出来。
我看谁敢？田龙不要仗着你是大长老就可以肆无忌惮伤害弟子，李天说的没错。人家根本没犯规。何错之有？
我赞同王长老的说法，林天也回应道。
又是这两个人跟自己作对，要是眼神能杀死人，估计王维和林天早就被田龙杀了。
执法堂人面对两位长老的阻拦，也得顾其面子，也不敢上前。
就在这时，执法堂堂主鲁剑说道。你们愣着干嘛？给我拿下李天。
鲁剑知道会得罪王维和林天，但是大长老和张图显然对自己有利，一个大长老权利滔天，一个丹药堂长老那丹药是可以多谋取些，这个时候卖他们面子肯定少不了自己好处。
执法堂的人虽然给各位长老面子，但也是属于执法堂。自己堂主叫拿人了，那必须得听。
也不再犹豫，把李天围在中间。化神巅峰的副堂主恐怖的威压释放出来，你是跟我们走还是我们押着你走，一个副堂主开口道。
面对三个化凡中期和一个化神期巅峰的人，还有两个天神境的长老田龙和张图，李天自知跑不了，但是要让自己束手就擒那肯定是不可能。一边想着对策一边想着思索着游龙步能不能在三个天神境下逃走。
就在这时李天脑海中响起了一个声音，小天你走，我拼命拦住他们。

李天对这个声音熟悉王维长老的声音，李天看了看王维微微一笑，已经做好了爷孙俩拼命的准备。
轰、轰，轰，三声巨响一个巨大的酒葫芦从天而降然后缩小。直奔大长老脑袋而去，只听砰的一声响起，田龙倒飞了出去摔地上。
田龙大惊，自己好歹也是天神境中期，竟然不是一个葫芦的对手。
田龙你的狗胆肥了是不是？宗门教给你管理，处于信任。你看你都干了什么？
当众人看清来人时，长老席上的人和一些精英弟子对着老者一拜。
拜见副宗主，当所有人听到这句话才明白这个遭老头子是副宗主。可是看到这样的人谁会想到是一个副宗主，一点高层样子没有，出场就是一点面子也不给长老，开口就是骂。
就连李天也是有的错愕，他虽然在宗门长大，但是从没见过副宗主，都是田龙在管理着宗门一直以为他就是副宗主!

Chapter 13 The Domineering Deputy Master (Page 1)
The great elder watched his grandson being kicked out by Li Tian, and he became determined to kill Li Tian. He immediately flew out of the elder's seat and fed him two healing pills. Then ask someone to take him down to rest.
Li Tian said again, when they bullied me, did anyone say a word for me? When they were destroying those fellow disciples in other arenas, did you say anything, now it is your grandson who is injured? Are you feeling distressed?
Li Tian's words were agreed by many people, especially those who were seriously injured. The elder was seriously shielding his family. Everyone felt that what Li Tian said made sense.
But no matter what Li Tian said? The great elder Tian Long had to let Li Tian die. No one could stop him from beating his grandson into a cripple, two more. If you cannot ascend to the realm of gods in your lifetime, you will be disabled for the rest of your life.
If the Law Enforcement Hall doesn't take action yet, why should such a devil be left with him? Seeing the people in the Law Enforcement Hall in a daze, the Great Elder yelled.
Dan Tang Zhang Tu also stood up and wanted to capture Li Tian.
Seeing that the Law Enforcement Hall was about to arrest Li Tian, ​​Wang Weihe stepped forward.
Let me see who dares? Tian Long, don't just rely on you being the Great Elder to harm your disciples unscrupulously, Li Tian is right. There was no foul play at all. What's wrong?
I agree with Elder Wang's statement, Lin Tian also responded.
These two people were against him again. If looks could kill, Wang Wei and Lin Tian would have been killed by Tian Long long ago.
Faced with the obstruction of the two elders, the members of the Law Enforcement Hall had to consider their face and did not dare to step forward.
At this moment, Lu Jian, the head of the law enforcement hall, said. Why are you standing there? Get Li Tian for me.
Lu Jian knew that he would offend Wang Wei and Lin Tian, ​​but the Great Elder and Zhang Tu were obviously beneficial to him. A Great Elder had overwhelming power, and an Elder of the Pill Hall could get more pills. Selling their face at this time would definitely benefit him.
Although the people from the Law Enforcement Hall give face to the elders, they still belong to the Law Enforcement Hall. If the master of your hall calls for someone to be taken, you must listen.
He no longer hesitated and surrounded Li Tian in the middle. The terrifying coercion of the deputy hall master at the peak of the transformation of gods was released. "Do you want to go with us or should we escort you?" a deputy hall master said.
Facing three people in the middle stage of mortal transformation and one person in the peak stage of divine transformation, as well as two elders in the realm of gods, Tian Long and Zhang Tu, Li Tian knew that he couldn't run away, but it was definitely impossible to capture him without any help. While thinking about countermeasures, he thought about whether You Longbu could escape in the realm of three gods.
At this moment, a voice sounded in Li Tian's mind, Xiaotian, please leave, I will try my best to stop them.
Li Tian was familiar with this voice of elder Wang Wei. Li Tian looked at Wang Wei and smiled slightly, and he was already ready for the two of them to fight tooth and nail.
Boom, boom, boom, three loud noises, a huge wine gourd fell from the sky and then shrank. Heading straight for the great elder's head, there was a bang and Tian Long flew out and fell to the ground.
Tian Long was shocked. He was still in the middle stage of the God Realm after all, and he was no match for a gourd.
Tian Long, is your dog fat? The sect teaches you management and relies on trust. Look what you have done?
When everyone saw who was coming, the people at the elders' table and some elite disciples bowed to the old man.
Meet the deputy sect master. When everyone heard these words, they realized that this old man was the deputy sect master. But seeing a person like this, who would have thought that he was a deputy sect leader. He didn't look like a high-ranking person at all. He didn't give any face to the elders when he appeared, and he just scolded him when he opened his mouth.
Even Li Tian was a little surprised. Although he grew up in the sect, he had never seen the deputy sect leader. Tian Long was the one who managed the sect and always thought he was the deputy sect leader!
